name: DCA Jack-Jack Cookie Num Nums Gluten-Friendly / Jam-Free Incredi-Cookie Shortbread
brandOrRestaurant: Jack-Jack Cookie Num Nums (Pixar Pier · Disney California Adventure)
whyItWorks: Jack-Jack's cart always stocks a dedicated Gluten-Friendly Shortbread Cookie—just check whether the current filling uses seedless blackberry/strawberry jam or eat the crumbly butter shortbread cookie sides.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask at the window for the Gluten-Friendly Cookie and scrape out the center jam if it contains berry seeds.
watchOuts: Center jam filling sometimes contains berry seeds—eat around the jam center if flaring
